snippet.title: The Hell Bread Trailer
snippet.description:
The Hell Bread - This is a game created by the indie studio Elite Studios, a 2D pixel platformer where we have to go through levels of different difficulty. As of August 2026, only a demo of the game is coming out.

Music:
Pixelland - Kevin MacLeod
8bit Dungeon Boss - Kevin MacLeod
